scope: Sequential synthetic host measurements on a local offscreen software backend.
limitations: No real catalog, system input, physical presentation, cleared OS caches, or isolated system load. Child logs remain local.

warmReport.boundary: host show request to exposed focused enabled search field, then a synchronized frame and a separately verified synthetic key; first reveal follows initialized QML and catalog; not physical presentation or cold OS startup
warmReport.scope: real DesktopWindowHost with synthetic anchor, placement, tray and catalog; no system hooks or real user input

freshSummary.scope: fresh synthetic test processes with a real host and simulated platform
freshSummary.boundary: first reveal after QGuiApplication exists; fixture time includes QML and catalog setup; process lifetime includes teardown; OS caches are not cleared and no physical input or display is measured
